issues.explanation: The decorative blue circle overlays directly on top of the hero headline text, making several words difficult to read.
issues.location_in_image: Hero headline text "Create Professional and Neat Diagrams in Minutes"
issues.suggested_fix: Move or resize the blue circle background element so it stays behind or beside the text without obstructing readability.

issues.explanation: Two identical primary buttons labeled "Generate Free Diagrams" compete for attention in the header and hero area at the same time.
issues.location_in_image: Top-right navigation bar button "Generate Free Diagrams"
issues.suggested_fix: Style the header button as a simple text link or secondary button so the hero section's primary call-to-action remains the key focus.

issues.explanation: The dark grey-blue text inside the pill container fails minimum contrast requirements against the dark background, reducing legibility.
issues.suggested_fix: Increase the text color brightness to white or light gray to achieve at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against the dark background.

issues.explanation: The looping dashed arrow line crosses through the hero section and creates redundant visual clutter around the primary button.
issues.location_in_image: Dashed white arrow graphic pointing to hero button
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the dashed arrow graphic to streamline the hero section layout and reduce visual distractions.
